sample_unit: AI-generated brochures (5 emergency conditions x 2 tools)

links.outcome: Flesch reading ease of AI-generated emergency brochures for patients
links.effect: Mean Flesch ease scores were 41.88 (ChatGPT) and 50.62 (Gemini), indicating difficult, college-level readability, with no significant difference between tools (p=0.3796).
links.quote: In addition, Gemini's brochures were slightly easier to read with a higher ease score (50.62 vs. 41.88).

screen.reason: The study directly evaluates the readability (Flesch-Kincaid) and reliability (Modified DISCERN) of patient education brochures generated by ChatGPT and Gemini for emergency medical conditions, but it does not compare outcomes with and without a specific guardrail or deployment practice.
